verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented end-to-end latency target or measured latency path for live conversation. The closest items are generic 'low-latency' wording for data tracks, an observability view that shows latency metrics, and an 'instant responses' claim for always-on agents. These are adjacent features, not a documented latency budget or a measured conversational pipeline.

support.subject: As a developer, the vendor documents an end-to-end latency target or measured latency path suitable for live conversation
